name: Domhnach Chrom Dubh
text: Domhnach Chrom Dubh means Sunday of Crom Dubh in Irish. MacKillop gives the name as another name for Lughnasa. The harvest festival at Lughnasa sits at the heart of late-summer Irish tradition. Crom Dubh's hiding was once blamed for bad harvests. The linkage to that older stratum sits inside the harvest festival of Lughnasa. The older Sunday-of-Crom-Dubh observance gets absorbed into the wider Lugh festival complex. The harvest traditions of late summer carried Crom Dubh's older stratum forward.

okr.objective: Domhnach Chrom Dubh as an Irish harvest-Sunday name for Lughnasa.
key_results: The name means Sunday of Crom Dubh.
MacKillop treats it as another name for Lughnasa.
It sits in the late-summer harvest tradition.
Crom Dubh is the older mythological figure behind the festival.
